workers.introduction: A calm, friendly presence with a passion for making everyday life a little easier.
workers.biography:
Hello, I’m Sarah. I believe good care begins with listening. I take time to understand the little things that make each day feel comfortable, familiar and enjoyable.

I bring 5 years of fictional experience supporting adults and families, with a particular interest in maintaining independence and building a reassuring routine. Outside work, I enjoy gardening, cooking and walks in the countryside.

This is a fictional CareMatch demo profile. All experience and qualifications are illustrative.
